name: Budesonide Suspension 0.250mg/2ml or 0.125mg/ml for nebulization, 1 piece
description: Budesonide nebulizer suspension 0.500 mg/2 ml is a glucocorticoid used to treat persistent asthma and other respiratory conditions that cause airway inflammation. Unlike bronchodilators, which provide rapid relief, this medication works by reducing inflammation over a longer period. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
